notes.title: We’re at Ukrainian Games Festival 2025 with Timeloop: Sink Again Beach!
notes.notes: [p][b]Ukrainian Games Festival[/b] is a week of bright premieres, demos, and discounts. From [b]August 14 to 21[/b], Steam turns into a grand stage for Ukrainian games — from indie gems to projects by veteran studios. The vibe is welcoming, loud, and very us — join in![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43152841/674c180dd415ca1b4433b9f2ae7a4dde5dfa4d86.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re bringing [b]Timeloop: Sink Again Beach[/b] — a 3D adventure with a time loop and a pirate vibe. Shorelines, a shipwreck, shady characters, and a day that keeps repeating, where every attempt opens new paths. Explore the island, solve puzzles, take risks, and boldly break the script — this story rewards the cunning and decisive.[/p][p][/p][p]Best of all — [b]the game is on sale during the festival with a deep discount[/b]. Grab your copy, share your impressions, and don’t forget to visit other participants — there’s a sea of genres and pleasant surprises. [/p][p][/p][h3]See you at UGF — let’s make this gaming celebration together![/h3]

notes.title: I WANT TO BELIEVE
notes.notes:
Hello! We've been working on *I Want to Believe* for over a year, and we're excited to present our new project. This first-person game blends elements of detective work, stealth, and simulation, immersing you in a cozy yet dangerous town in northern USA.

Among the locals, aliens are hiding, disguised as humans. Your task is to identify these intruders, eliminate them, and remain unnoticed. A reliable pickup truck, a camera, and a bit of cunning will be your allies. But be careful: the local police don’t believe in aliens and won’t forgive any mistakes.

[h3]Game Features:[/h3]  
[list]  
[*] Freedom of action – decide what to do and how to approach each situation.  
[*] Immersive atmosphere and engaging gameplay.  
[*] Realistic car physics and detailed pickup truck driving simulation.  
[*] Local radio with a great playlist to set the mood for your adventure.  
[/list]

[b]We're getting closer to release, so add *I Want to Believe* to your wishlist on Steam to be the first to know when it launches![/b]  

[h1]Your support means the world to us![/h1]  

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739150/I_Want_to_Believe/

notes.title: METROPHOBIA - New horror with anomalies! 🎃
notes.notes:
Friends, we are working on an entirely new project — Metrophobia! This eerie and unsettling experience takes place in an abandoned metro, trapping you in an endless cycle of anomalies and darkness. Every time you try to escape, the station resets, while sinister creatures and strange distortions challenge your sanity.

Metrophobia already has its own page on Steam, and we invite you to add it to your wishlist. By doing so, you'll be among the first to hear news about the game and its release.

🎯 Join us in this liminal nightmare! Adding the game to your wishlist ensures that you won't miss any announcements or updates.

[h1]Check out Metrophobia's page[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265490/Metrophobia/

notes.title: Melior Max Plays the Timeloop: Sink Again Beach – Join the Stream!
notes.notes:
Join us for an exciting let's play as [b]Ukraine’s top gaming blogger, Melior Max[/b], dives into the prologue of [b]Timeloop: Sink Again Beach[/b]. Known for his engaging commentary and deep analysis, Melior Max will guide you through the twisted narrative and quirky humor that define the game. Don’t miss the chance to see how he handles the challenging puzzles and unexpected twists of this time-bending adventure!

Whether you're a fan of Melior Max or curious about what *Timeloop: Sink Again Beach* has to offer, this stream is the perfect way to experience the game firsthand. Watch as he uncovers secrets, interacts with bizarre characters, and showcases what makes this prologue a must-play for fans of comedic adventures.
